items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: The next time I heard of Ben he was with Teddy Wilson's big band.

ctx.x: Yeah, across the street from Pickwick. And first we had a -- Ben didn't come out here with us. We had Quinichette Paul Clinche, he didn't stay. Allen Eager came in. He didn't stay. And both of them were trying to play like Ben Webster at that time. So, Zoot come in with this funny-looking smile on his face. He's about the color of your sweater, which is red, and shy. Came up, played the keys off the horn. Sounded like Lester Young.

items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: if I had told that I had recorded with Big Sid and Ben on the record date

ctx.x: And so what you were saying, the reason you couldn't testify in Court --

Oh, the reasons I couldn't testify in Court was because this was a black market record date, you know. We wasn't supposed to be recording. And Big-Ben asked for his price and it was confirmed. Sid asked for his price, it was confirmed. I asked for my price and it was confirmed. So when he filed charges on me, and I had to go to court, I couldn't tell the story. I was handcuffed, because if I had told that I had recorded with Big Sid and Ben on the record date, they would have been thrown out of the union as well…
Did Parrish get paid, do you know?
